- **#15:** "tokio, ecosystem is bigger", said a few seconds later.

I treated #15 as the latest word and left async-std out of the file, as you asked. `muninn why` reported "insufficient" because nothing is recorded at trust 2 or higher. If tokio isn't actually the decision, tell me and I'll change the file to say nothing is recorded.

This is a Go project (gin), so a Rust runtime is an odd fit. I didn't check that.
